action: Unchanged Candidate 1, leading classical D=0 local Minkowski solver; no expansion, thermal bath or gravitational backreaction
purpose: Resolve what the already chosen preparations say about opposite-vacuum domains, and audit the review's cosmological escape thresholds
exposure: Retrospective. Archived min(S) values and endpoint fields were available before this protocol. Not a held-out or blinded empirical prediction.
run_parameters: Copy each named execution.json case and original command options, including dt and scalar sample interval. Only observational code is inserted. No new initial condition or action parameter.
sampling: Full-grid field-only scan at t=0 and every drift step, before the next kick. Coordinates q are synchronized; no momentum-dependent quantity is added at the staggered step.

diagnostics.record: minS, maxS, counts S<0, S<-0.1, S<-0.25, S<-0.5, S<-0.75, S<-0.9; count S<-0.5 and F2<0.1; count S>0.5 and F2<0.1; negative-cell mean F2
diagnostics.endpoint: For every archived endpoint, evaluate sign occupancy, negative-cell F2 quantiles, and opposite-branch low-X plateau counts at all thresholds. These are subsample statistics except where stride=1.
diagnostics.wall_interpretation: S<0 alone is not a vacuum wall. Both near-vacuum plateaus and an interpolating interface are necessary diagnostics; network persistence/percolation, expansion and cosmological population remain additional requirements. Counts do not define particles. Thresholds do not prove topology.

controls: Compare rerun original scalar histories and endpoint fields with archived values; diagnostics must not materially change trajectories. Check three spatial grids. No continuum-time positivity theorem, new cosmological lifetime, thermal network or new empirical exclusion is inferred.
cosmology_sensitivity: Retain original six-row sensitivity corners. Independently calculate separate negative constant vacuum and negative curvature escapes with physical density fixed by the original classical floor. No SN/BAO calibration, new likelihood significance or cosmologically viable fit is adopted.
stop: If no near-negative-vacuum plateau appears, report that boundary and send Claude the histories. Do not launch an expanding thermal network campaign until a thermal history and meaningful cosmological target are specified.
